form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Scott of Florida (for himself, Mr. Rubio, and Mr. Padilla) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources

form.official-title: To designate the National Pulse Memorial located at 1912 South Orange Avenue in Orlando, Florida, and for other purposes.

subsection.text: The Pulse Memorial located at 1912 South Orange Avenue in Orlando, Florida, is designated as the National Pulse Memorial.

paragraph.text: The national memorial designated by subsection (a) is not a unit of the National Park System.
The designation of the national memorial by subsection (a) shall not require or permit Federal funds to be expended for any purpose relating to the national memorial.
